req.title: Reject empty firstName
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the Player payload contains an empty firstName.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-022 requires HTTP 422 when firstName is empty string. We need: (1) a positive case proving a valid non-empty firstName yields 201, (2) a negative case proving empty string firstName yields exactly 422, (3) a boundary case proving a single-character firstName (length=1, the minimum non-empty boundary) yields 201 while empty string (length=0) yields 422. Additional cases cover whitespace-only firstName and null firstName to strengthen mutation kill rate by testing both sides of the validation boundary.

tests.name: test_post_player_valid_firstname_returns_201
preconditions: Squad number 99 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with a fully valid payload including non-empty firstName
expected: Response body contains firstName matching submitted value
Response body contains a valid UUID id field
trace: R-PLAYER-022: valid firstName must NOT trigger 422
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_valid_firstname_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Lionel",
        "lastName": "Messi",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Right Winger"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "Lionel"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Messi"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert "id" in body
    assert body["id"] is not None

tests.name: test_post_player_empty_vs_nonempty_firstname_status_codes_differ
preconditions: Squad numbers 94 and 95 do not exist in the database
actions: Assert the two status codes are different and exactly correct
expected: Status codes are not equal to each other
trace: R-PLAYER-022: BVA tests both sides of the empty/non-empty boundary to catch off-by-one and comparison-operator mutations
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_empty_vs_nonempty_firstname_status_codes_differ():
    empty_payload = {
        "firstName": "",
        "lastName": "Test",
        "squadNumber": 94,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r_empty = client.post("/players/", json=empty_payload)
    assert r_empty.status_code == 422

    valid_payload = {
        "firstName": "AB",
        "lastName": "Test",
        "squadNumber": 95,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r_valid = client.post("/players/", json=valid_payload)
    assert r_valid.status_code == 201

    assert r_empty.status_code != r_valid.status_code
